name: relay-ticket-forge-1
description: ADR-038 §6.2 forge/refusal corpus: one row per hostile presentation, each with the expected status+reason under the frozen first-failure-wins ORDER (signature precedes binding; syntax precedes signature). Rows re-derive in-code by the consuming tests (mutate the relay-ticket-1 fixture); wire_tokens are provided for the rows where a concrete byte form is meaningful (base64url mutations are deterministic).
binding_note: PLACEHOLDER PAIR — this fixture's installation_id does NOT re-derive from the peer_id under the real ADR-020 rule (the Security review's binding drift ruling (b), 2026-10-15: split coverage accepted — checks 1-6 pinned here; check 7-8 binding pinned by the implementation's re-derived fixtures + the in-process end-to-end proofs). The next vector revision regenerates accept/expired/forge with a properly-derived pair AND records the peer identity seed so checks 7-8 become replayable cross-language (T/R concurrence adds the seed requirement).
